thread:
Maria J. (CSM): quick weekly health note for OrionHealth — top-level items: usage +12% week-over-week, spend flat, small uptick in 5xx errors on generate endpoints. latency breakdown (p95/p99) by route + model below, streaming (chunked) vs blocking sync calls differ quite a bit, see callouts.

Maria J. (CSM): Metrics snapshot (last 7d):
```
route                  | model                 | p95(ms)  | p99(ms)  | streaming p95/p99(ms) | sync p95/p99(ms)
/generate              | redwood-3.1-35b-q4    | 210      | 780      | 250 / 820             | 190 / 420
/chat-stream           | redwood-3.1-7b        | 120      | 290      | 140 / 310             | 110 / 260
/embeddings            | emb-lite-1            | 45       | 110      | n/a                   | 48 / 120
/rerank                | rank-small            | 90       | 220      | 95 / 240              | 88 / 210

notes: generate streaming path shows wide p99 tail (~820ms) vs sync path (420ms) — likely due to intermittent rebuffering and one-hot KV cache misses. error-rate on /generate ~0.6% (baseline 0.1%).
```

Ajay K. (Customer Ops): are these errors user-facing or internal retries? Any correlation with request size? :thinking_face:

Maria J. (CSM): mostly user-facing 5xx, spike aligns with longer prompts (>2k tokens) and a bump in simultaneous streaming sessions (~+30%).

Ben L. (SRE): I pulled a few traces — seeing periodic OOM/restart on worker pool serving the 35b-quant variant around 02:00 UTC. GC spikes right before the tail latencies. I'll attach logs to the ticket.

Ellie R. (Eng - Prod): thanks Ben. two quick mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily route large streaming calls to the 7b-stream-safe model for Orion while we debug; 2) tighten streaming chunk size from 1k -> 512 tokens to reduce peak mem. can implement a canary in the routing policy.

Maria J. (CSM): action items:
- @Ben L. create incident/ticket and include worker logs + sample traces (ETA 2h) :white_check_mark:
- @Ellie R. propose routing change + canary config (ETA EOD) :calendar:
- @Ajay K. flag renewal risk if tail persists next week (threshold: p99 > 700ms for generate route) :warning:

Ajay K. (Customer Ops): noted, will add to the account risk tracker and prep a short enablement note for the customer explaining temporary routing.

Ben L. (SRE): incident created: INC-2026-0789. attaching first log bundle to the ticket. early suspicion: reduced free memory due to long-lived KV cache entries for large contexts.

alertbot: Automated alert — routing rule change detected in us-east-1 for pool "orion-35b-quant" at 1912351200. If this was unexpected, reply "revert" within 15m.

Maria J. (CSM): I'll loop in PM + Austin from solutions tomorrow for a follow-up call. thanks everyone, will post an update once we have canary numbers. :pray:
